“我的感觉是我们丢了两分，”阿尔特塔说。“我们在上半场表现极其出色，但我们需要打进三到四个球，而我们没有做到。我们知道对方会有所回应，但我们送给纽卡斯尔第一个球的方式完全不可接受。我们扳平并打进了第二个球，但我们缺少杀死比赛的神来之笔。我不认为我们在下半场松懈了；有时候你必须称赞对手。”
下半场的出色表现挽救了这场比赛，也让在现场观看比赛的纽卡斯尔主席亚西尔·阿勒鲁梅扬露出了笑容。他从利雅得飞来观看他本赛季的第一场比赛，据信他在赛后称赞了主教练。
“你在下半场看到的是纯粹的纽卡斯尔基因，这是我们可以继续建立的基础，”雅伊斯勒说。“但我们必须保持谦逊和现实。上半场表现不好，下半场非常出色。我的心情很复杂，因为本可能取得更多成果，但平局可能算是公平的。”
“我在中场休息时有点沮丧，但我们鼓励球员以正确的方式进行高位逼抢并采取积极主动的姿态。没有犹豫，没有怀疑，只有纯粹的信念，我们做到了。我知道我们有能力做到这一点，所以我真的很高兴。我们感受到了与球迷之间难以置信的联系和协同效应。”
“能让像阿森纳这样优秀的球队在你们的球场感到畏惧是不可思议的。我希望我们能将这种感觉延续下去。”

items.titleEn: Newcastle United 2-2 Arsenal: Premier League – as it happened
items.summaryEn: Newcastle roared back to take in a thrilling second half before Noni Madueke’s equaliser earned Arsenal a point“There is an ebb and a flow to Arsenal’s front three, isn’t there?” writes Charles Antaki. “Eze, Havertz, Madueke – in any given game, one will delight and the other two disappoint; one will score and the other two will be all over the place; one will bring joy, and the other two will invite cursing and the gnashing of teeth. And all this is not to mention the chap lurking on the bench. Personally – I admit it – I’d rather have three fully functioning goal machines, but there we are.”We hate it when our teams become successful.He’s prepared emotionally; he knows to accept. We have to be very dominant emotionally to attack Newcastle in the way we want, and he’s ready to do that. Continue reading...
bodyEn: That’s all for tonight. Thank you for your company and especially all the lovely emails, which have left me feeling warm, fuzzy and a bit emotional. Goodnight!
Louise Taylor’s match report: Newcastle 2-2 Arsenal
If Mikel Arteta was delighted to see the back of Eddie Howe as Newcastle’s head coach, the bad news is that another similarly awkward technical area adversary has been installed at St James’ Park.

If Arsenal’s manager never seemed to relish trips to face Howe’s old team, Arteta certainly did not enjoy this latest trip to Tyneside where Matthias Jaissle’s initially overwhelmed team fought back to earn a point courtesy of a stellar second-half performance.

“That ended up being a great game,” writes Chris Paraskevas, “and while a win would have given PIF & MJ a massive psychological boost, this is a reminder of the necessary template for home games: get in the opposition’s face and make them uncomfortable and move the ball quickly and forwards, because the Geordies respond to hard work and endeavour more than they fancy concepts like vertical football.

“A draw is probably fair. Some encouraging performances from a number of players. Now they need to find some consistency. And I need to use the rest of my Sunday to hook up a date/get to 25% completion on GTA VI. Take care of yourself mate - great to have you back!”
Cheers Chris. It’s great to be back, especially when I get to work on games like that.
The updated Premier League table

That was a blistering second half, one that has the potential to kickstart Matthias Jaissle’s reign. He made a triple substitution at half-time, with Newcastle 1-0 down and being comprehensively outplayed. The impact was instant, and for the next half an hour Newcastle battered the best team in England.
Harvey Barnes equalised, Malick Thiaw put them in front and they came close to take a 3-1 lead before Noni Madueke scored the equaliser for Arsenal. Great entertainment, lovely stuff.
… but it’s over now. Barnes is booked after the final whistle, presumably because the referee thought he dived when Rice challenged him.
90+10 min Barnes thinks he’s fouled on the edge of the area by Rice. The referee disagrees. Pulsating stuff…
90+8 min At the other end, Gyokeres curls over from the left side of the area. A tougher chance than Ramsey’s – the angle was tighter and he was under more pressure.

90+7 mim Barnes leaves Rice in his slipstream, turns inside and finds Ramsey to his right. He moves to the edge of the area, opens his body and… sidefoots high over the bar. Ach, that was half a chance. The ball may have bobbled.
90+6 min Barnes moves promisingly down the left, only to lift a cross into the arms of Kepa.
90+4 min: Double substitution for Arsenal Viktor Gyokeres and Mikel Merino, a specialist in late winners, replace Martin Odegaard and Kai Havertz.
90+2 min: Newcastle substitution Sven Botman replaces the limping Lewis Hall, whose error for the opening goal feels a long time ago.
90 min Oh go on then: there will be nine minutes of extra entertainment.
90 min Madueke’s corner from the right brushes the head of Thiaw and bounces a few yards wide of the far post. Eeeeeeeeeeeeesh this is tense.
87 min At the other end, Ramsey nips in front of Timber (I think) to make an important clearance.
85 min Ramsey, who has been excellent since coming on at half-time, wins a corner on the left. Neither team looks happy with a point.
84 min A Newcastle free-kick leads to a shot from Thiaw that deflects wide. He was offside anyway, so what’s your flippin’ point?
83 min: Newcastle substitution Yoane Wissa on, Joe Willock off.
81 min Arsenal came from behind to nick a late win at St James’ Park this season. There’s a bit of metaphorical lightning in the air.
80 min Burn gives Timber a mouthful after fouling him near the touchline. Madueke charges in and squares up to Burn, a brave move that almost leads to Burn putting him on his rump.
Burn and Madueke are booked.

Noni Madueke continues his excellent form with a vital goal. It came from a superb counter-attack, led inevitably by Odegaard. He played the ball outside to Madueke, who veered infield and into the area with inent. Madueke dummied a couple of defenders before hitting a deflected shot from 15 yards that squirmed through Hornicek.
Arsenal equalise out of nothing!

75 min: Chance for Newcastle Kepa dives at the feet of Miley, who surged through after the deftest of touches from Barnes. There was some talk from the commentators that Miley was briefly pulled back by Rice, but nobody appealed for a penalty. Replays show a slight touch on the arm.
74 min Hall’s floated corner hits the top of Havertz’s head and loops onto the top of the crossbar! Right now – and I know there’s a long way to go – Arsenal are hanging on to a 2-1 deficit.

73 min For the umpteenth time in the second half, Newcastle win the ball and go straight for the heart of the Arsenal defence. Willock hits a low shot from 25 yards that takes a big deflection, wrongfoots Kepa and bounces well wide.

70 min: Triple substitution for Arsenal Kepa, Myles Lewis-Skelly (No49 ladies and gents) and Christos Tzolis come on for David Raya, Eberechi Eze and Bruno Guimaraes. You can imagine the noise being made by the Newcastle fans as he leaves the field.
69 min Yep, Raya is really struggling and is being helped off the field with his left arm being held tight to his body. Kepa Arrizabalaga is getting ready to replace him.
67 min Raya goes down holding his left shoulder after an innocuous-looking collision with Osula. I say innocuous-looking because you never really know with shoulders.
66 min Newcastle’s second-half performance has been utterly brilliant. It’s hard, in the heat of the moment, to assess whether Arsenal have played badly or just been overwhelmed.
65 min Willock runs on to a deft pass from Osula and hits the side netting from a very tight angle.
64 min: The goal stands! “Wowsers,” says Niall Mullen. “Newcastle were such a shower in the first half I was ready to relegate them. It’s a funny old game Saint.”
63 min: VAR check Hang on, there’s a check for a potential offside/handball/anything.

Newcastle have battered Arsenal since half-time and now they’re in front. Hall swung a deep corner to the bizarrely unmarked Burn, whose header hit a Newcastle player on the line as Gabriel and Raya fell backwards into the net. The ball ran loose and was poked in from a yard by Thiaw. Goodness me.
What a sensational turnaround!
62 min Eze slips while playing a short backpass to Raya, whose attempted clearance his Livramento, dribbles towards goal and is put behind for a corner by Gabriel.

60 min Miley splatters a rising drive from 25 yards. It’s straight at Raya, who pats it down comfortably, but it was beautifully struck with his right foot. Newcastle are all over Arsenal – but they have to score now because otherwise we know how this ends.
58 min Barnes is booked for legging up Ezri Konsa. Newcastle have snapped away at Arsenal since the break.
57 min Barnes floats a dangerous free-kick that is headed away crucially by Havertz. Burn was behind him, six yards out, ready to snap his neck and head past Raya.
56 min Hall is fouled 25 yards from goal by Rice, who is inevitably booked. This match has changed completely.
55 min Since half-time, Newcastle have had 78% possession.
52 min All of a sudden Newcastle fancy this. Willock runs away from Rice on the halfway line and moves to within 25 yards of goal before curling over.
Rice is also limping. Arsenal’s title defence is in tatters.

Newcastle are level! Odegaard tried to play a bouncing ball forward but sliced it behind his back and into the path of Osula. He moved into the area and played an inviting square pass to the onrushing Harvey Barnes, who swept a decisive finish to the right of David Raya.
Who saw that coming?
48 min Raya gets to his feet after a couple of minutes’ treatment. Kepa Arrizabalaga is warming up but it looks as if Raya is fine.
46 min Within 20 seconds of the restart, David Raya dives bravely at the feet of Willock. Good goalkeeping. Raya was caught accidentally on the head by Willock and will need treatment.
Newcastle are making a triple substitution at half-time. Tino Livramento, Anthony Elanga and Jacob Ramsey are on for Jacob Murphy, Sean Steur and Amar Dedic.
Musical interlude
Premier League match reports
Manchester City 1-1 Fulham
Aston Villa 0-0 Sunderland
Bournemouth 2-0 Nottm Forest
Chelsea 1-4 Leeds
Coventry 3-2 Crystal Palace
Tottenham 2-0 Ipswich

Eze’s free-kick is punched away by Hornicek, the last action of a first half that ends with boos from the home fans. Arsenal are on course to go eight points clear at the top. They wore Newcastle down during an ultimately one-sided first half, with Kai Havertz and the scorer Eberechi Eze combining for a fine goal. This isn’t news, but Arsenal are a seriously good football team.

45 min: Fine block by Hall! Odegaard gets away on the left and slides an inviting low cross to Madueke, who looks certain to score until Hall gets round to deflect his shot over the bar. Brilliant defending.

43 min: Good save by Hornicek! Madueke robs Hall, who is having a dodgy spell, and sets off towards goal. He gallops into the area, just about keeps his balance and drives a low right-foot shot from the angle that is kicked away by Hornicek.
41 min Barnes has a speculative shot blocked after a decent raid down the left by Osula. That’s the first time in ages that Newcastle have penetrated the final third.
39 min Calafiori cuts inside from the right – don’t ask me, he’s the left-back – and screws a shot well wide.
Gabriel may have an injury problem; he’s feeling his side. William Saliba is among the subs.

38 min “I’m sorry to hear that Charles Antaki’s lobster is too buttery and his diamond shoes are too tight (5.14pm),” writes Matt Dony. “The front three might not be Salah/Mane/Firmino (sob) but they’re doing a job. Whether Kari Tulinius likes it or not, I’d like to congratulate Arsenal on the successful defence of their title. Stick a fork in it. Roll on next season.”

37 min Newcastle will be frustrated that the goal stemmed from an error, and surprised that the man responsible was the usually excellent Lewis Hall. It was a split-second misjudgement that was punished ruthlessly by Havertz and Eze.
35 min “Such prescience,” says Richard Hirst. “What lottery numbers have you picked?”
Pah, that’s an insult! The lottery is pure luck. But there’s nothing lucky about a stopped clock showing the correct time twice a day.

items.titleZh: 纽卡斯尔联 2-2 阿森纳：英超联赛实时战报
items.summaryZh: 马杜埃凯扳平比分，阿森纳客场2比2战平纽卡斯尔联。
bodyZh: 今天的直播就到这里。感谢大家的陪伴，特别是所有温暖人心的邮件，让我感到温暖和一丝感动。晚安！
路易斯·泰勒的比赛报告：纽卡斯尔联 2-2 阿森纳
如果说米克尔·阿尔特塔很高兴看到埃迪·豪离开纽卡斯尔联的主教练岗位，那么坏消息是，圣詹姆斯公园球场又迎来了一位同样难缠的技术区对手。
如果说这位阿森纳主帅过去并不太喜欢客场对阵埃迪·豪的旧部，那么阿尔特塔显然更不喜欢这次泰恩赛德之行。马蒂亚斯·贾伊斯勒的球队在上半场一度被完全压制，但在下半场凭借出色的表现奋起直追，最终扳平比分。
“这最终是一场精彩的比赛，”克里斯·帕拉凯瓦斯写道，“虽然一场胜利会给PIF和MJ带来巨大的心理鼓舞，但这提醒了主场比赛的必要模板：紧逼对手让他们感到不舒服，快速向前传球，因为吉尔迪人更看重努力和拼搏，而不是纵向足球之类的概念。”
“平局或许是公平的。许多球员都有令人鼓舞的表现。现在他们需要找到一些稳定性。而我需要利用周日剩下的时间去约会或者把GTA VI的进度推到25%。保重兄弟——很高兴你回来！”
不客气，克里斯。很高兴能回来，尤其是能解说这样精彩的比赛。
更新后的英超积分榜
那是令人窒息的下半场，有可能成为马蒂亚斯·贾伊斯勒执教生涯的转折点。他在中场休息时做出三人换人调整，当时纽卡斯尔联0-1落后且全面处于下风。效果立竿见影，在接下来的半小时里，纽卡斯尔联痛击了英格兰最好的球队。
哈维·巴恩斯扳平比分，马利克·佳夫将比分反超，他们甚至差点取得3-1的领先，随后马杜埃凯为阿森纳攻入扳平进球。精彩的娱乐，美妙的比赛。
……但比赛现在结束了。巴恩斯在终场哨响后被黄牌警告，大概是因为裁判认为他在赖斯的拼抢下假摔。
90+10分钟，巴恩斯认为自己在禁区边缘被赖斯犯规。裁判不这么认为。令人心跳加速的时刻……
90+8分钟，另一端，哲凯赖什在禁区左侧兜射高出。这是一个比拉姆齐更难的机会——角度更小，压力更大。
90+7分钟，巴恩斯将赖斯甩在身后，内切并找到了右侧的拉姆齐。他带到禁区边缘，身体张开……推射高出横梁。啊，这算是一个半机会。球可能有些弹跳。
90+6分钟，巴恩斯在左路颇具威胁地推进，但传中落入了凯帕的怀中。
90+4分钟：阿森纳做出换人调整，擅长绝杀的维克托·哲凯赖什和米克尔·梅里诺换下马丁·厄德高和凯·哈弗茨。
90+2分钟：纽卡斯尔联换人，斯文·博特曼换下有些一瘸一拐的路易斯·霍尔，他在失球时的失误已经是很久以前的事了。
90分钟：好吧，接下来还有九分钟的超长补时。
90分钟，马杜埃凯右侧开出角球，蹭到佳夫的头后弹出了远门柱几码外。天哪，这太紧张了。
87分钟，另一端，拉姆齐抢在廷贝尔（我想是的）之前完成了一次关键解围。
85分钟，下半场替补登场表现出色的拉姆齐在左侧赢得角球。双方似乎都对平局不满意。
84分钟，纽卡斯尔联的任意球导致佳夫的射门被封堵偏出。他本来就越位了，你还在争什么？
83分钟：纽卡斯尔联换人，约安·维萨上，乔·威洛克下。
81分钟，阿森纳本赛季曾在圣詹姆斯公园球场落后逆转绝杀。空气中弥漫着某种历史重演的氛围。
80分钟，伯恩在边线附近对廷贝尔犯规后喋喋不休。马杜埃凯冲上前去与伯恩对峙，这是一个勇敢的举动，差点让伯恩把他掀翻在地。
伯恩和马杜埃凯被黄牌警告。
农伊·马杜埃凯延续了出色的状态，攻入关键进球。这来自一次精彩的反击，毫无意外地由厄德高发起。他将球分给外侧的马杜埃凯，后者内切带入禁区。马杜埃凯假动作晃过两名后卫，在15码处起脚射门，皮球发生折射穿过了霍尔尼切克。
阿森纳凭空扳平比分！
75分钟：纽卡斯尔联的机会，凯帕神勇扑救挡出麦利的脚下球，后者在接巴恩斯精妙触球后杀入禁区。解说员曾提到麦利似乎被赖斯短暂拉拽，但没有人抗议点球。慢镜头显示手臂有轻微接触。
74分钟，霍尔开出飘忽的角球，击中哈弗茨的头顶后弹到横梁顶部！目前——我知道比赛还有很长一段路——阿森纳正艰难维持着1-2的落后。
73分钟，下半场不知第几次，纽卡斯尔联抢断后直插阿森纳防线腹地。威洛克在25码处低射，皮球发生巨大折射，骗过了凯帕，偏出立柱很多。
70分钟：阿森纳做出三人换人调整，凯帕、迈尔斯·刘易斯-斯凯利（49号先生女士们）和克里斯托斯·齐奥利斯换下大卫·拉亚、埃贝雷奇·埃泽和布鲁诺·吉马良斯。你可以想象当他离场时纽卡斯尔联球迷制造的噪音。
69分钟，是的，拉亚确实有些撑不住了，左臂紧贴着身体被搀扶离场。凯帕·阿里萨巴拉加正准备替补登场。
67分钟，拉亚在与奥苏拉一次看似无害的碰撞后倒地，捂着左肩膀。我说看似无害是因为肩膀的伤势你永远说不准。
66分钟，纽卡斯尔联下半场的表现简直太出色了。在激烈的比赛中很难评估阿森纳是踢得糟糕还是仅仅被打爆了。
65分钟，威洛克接奥苏拉的精妙传球突入，在极小角度下打中边网。
64分钟：进球有效！“天哪，”尼尔·穆伦说，“纽卡斯尔联上半场表现太烂了，我都准备降级他们了。圣徒球迷，足球真奇妙。”
63分钟：VAR介入，等等，正在检查潜在的越位/手球/任何情况。
纽卡斯尔联自下半场开始以来就压制了阿森纳，现在他们领先了。霍尔开出深远角球找到诡异无人盯防的伯恩，他的头球击中了门线上的纽卡斯尔联球员，加布里埃尔和拉亚双双倒退着摔入网窝。皮球散落，佳夫在距离球门一码处捅射破门。我的天啊。
多么轰动的逆转！
62分钟，埃泽在回传拉亚时滑倒，拉亚试图解围却踢中了利夫拉门托，皮球滚向球门，被加布里埃尔抢先解围出底线。
60分钟，麦利在25码处轰出一脚上旋远射。球正中拉亚下怀，他稳稳把球按住，但这脚右脚抽射确实非常漂亮。纽卡斯尔联全面压制阿森纳——但他们必须进球，否则我们都知道结局会如何。
58分钟，巴恩斯因绊倒埃兹里·孔萨被黄牌警告。下半场开始后，纽卡斯尔联一直对阿森纳穷追不舍。
57分钟，巴恩斯开出危险任意球，被哈弗茨关键头球解围。伯恩就埋伏在他身后六码处，随时准备将球顶进拉亚的大门。
56分钟，霍尔在距离球门25码处被赖斯犯规，赖斯无可避免地吃到黄牌。这场比赛完全变了样。
55分钟，下半场开始以来，纽卡斯尔联的控球率高达78%。
52分钟，纽卡斯尔联突然起势。威洛克在中线摆脱赖斯，带球推进到距离球门25码处后兜射高出。
赖斯也一瘸一拐的。阿森纳的卫冕之路摇摇欲坠。
纽卡斯尔联扳平比分！厄德高试图向前传出弹地球，却将球切到身后并落入奥苏拉脚下。他杀入禁区送出威胁横传，插上的哈维·巴恩斯果断推射破门，皮球飞入大卫·拉亚的右侧。
谁能想到这一点？
48分钟，拉亚经过几分钟的治疗后站了起来。凯帕·阿里萨巴拉加正在热身，但看起来拉亚没事。
46分钟，下半场刚开场20秒，大卫·拉亚神勇倒地扑救化解了威洛克的脚下球。出色的门将表现。拉亚在这次扑救中头部不小心被威洛克撞到，需要接受治疗。
纽卡斯尔联在中场休息时做出三人换人调整。蒂诺·利夫拉门托、安东尼·埃兰加和雅各布·拉姆齐换下雅各布·墨菲、肖恩·施图尔和阿马尔·代迪奇。
音乐插曲
英超比赛报告
曼城 1-1 富勒姆
阿斯顿维拉 0-0 桑德兰
伯恩茅斯 2-0 诺丁汉森林
切尔西 1-4 利兹联
考文垂 3-2 水晶宫
托特纳姆热刺 2-0 伊普斯维奇
埃泽的任意球被霍尔尼切克扑出，这也是上半场的最后一次进攻，半场结束时主场球迷发出了嘘声。阿森纳目前在积分榜上领先优势有望扩大到八分。他们在最终呈一边倒的上半场中逐渐消耗了纽卡斯尔联，凯·哈弗茨和进球功臣埃贝雷奇·埃泽配合攻入了一粒精彩的进球。这虽然不是新闻，但阿森纳确实是一支实力极其强大的球队。
45分钟：霍尔精彩封堵！厄德高在左路摆脱防守，送出威胁低平球到门前，马杜埃凯眼看必进无疑，但霍尔及时赶到将他的射门挡出横梁。出色的防守。
43分钟：霍尔尼切克精彩扑救！马杜埃凯抢断状态糟糕的霍尔后带球杀向球门。他全速冲入禁区，勉强保持平衡并在小角度起右脚低射，被霍尔尼切克用脚挡出。
41分钟，奥苏拉在左路完成一次不错的突袭后，巴恩斯的一脚远射被封堵。这是纽卡斯尔联很久以来第一次攻入对方进攻三区。
39分钟，卡拉菲奥里从右路内切——别问我为什么，他可是左后卫——随后一脚远射偏出很多。
加布里埃尔可能受伤了，他正捂着肋部。威廉·萨利巴在替补席上。
38分钟，“听说查尔斯·安塔基的龙虾黄油太多、钻石鞋太紧（下午5:14），我很难过，”马特·多尼写道，“前场三叉戟可能不是萨拉赫/马内/菲尔米诺（呜咽），但他们正在完成任务。不管卡里·图利纽斯喜欢与否，我要祝贺阿森纳成功卫冕冠军。尘埃落定。期待下个赛季。”
37分钟，纽卡斯尔联一定会对失球源于失误感到沮丧，并惊讶于罪魁祸首竟然是平时表现极佳的路易斯·霍尔。这是一个电光石火间的误判，被哈弗茨和埃泽无情地惩罚了。
35分钟，“多么富有先见之明，”理查德·赫斯特说，“你选了什么彩票号码？”
呸，这是侮辱！彩票纯属运气。但坏掉的时钟一天还能准两次，这可不是靠运气。

items.titleEn: Disabled Supporters' Ticket Info | Crystal Palace (A)
bodyEn: Crystal Palace v ArsenalSunday 27th December Premier LeagueSelhurst ParkKick Off: 19:00
Please note that all Ambulant seating for this away game has now sold out.

All tickets for this game will be NFC Digital Passes and will be sent to each lead client and must be added to a mobile device prior to arrival at Selhurst Park. Please ensure that your email address details are up to date.
Tickets will be sent from Monday, December 21. If you have not received your tickets by Wednesday, December 23, please contact our Supporter Services Team on 020 7619 5000 (option 1).
Supporters aged 13 and under must be accompanied by an adult ticket holder when entering Selhurst Park.
Selhurst Park is a cashless stadium, please note that cash will not be accepted at any food and drink outlets in the Arthur Wait Stand.

We ask that you only purchase a ticket if you are planning to attend the match. Our goal is to ensure that as many supporters as possible have the chance to attend this game, and that our away support remains vibrant and passionate.
When attending away fixtures, please ensure that your match ticket is scanned. It is your responsibility to make sure that your ticket is scanned correctly at the turnstile.
If your match ticket does not scan at the relevant turnstile, or if a steward admits you through another entrance, please ensure that your ticket is scanned before entering the ground.

If you do have access issues on the day of the game, please speak to a steward or seek advice from the hosting club’s ticket office before entering the ground to confirm that your match attendance is recorded.

Arsenal monitors away match attendance from access control data which is recorded at the hosting club’s ground. Arsenal receives this information directly from the hosting club and uses the data to confirm attendance or to deduct away match points.
Please be aware that documentation will not be accepted to prove away match attendance and this includes photographs, receipts, travel or hotel bookings.

If you fail to scan your away match ticket, Arsenal will not receive information that you attended the fixture, and the away match loyalty point that has been credited to your membership account will be removed for the relevant away game.
The club also reserves the right to implement further point removals for repeated occurrences as set out under section 3.10 of the Arsenal Away Match Ticket Terms and Conditions Season 2026-2027.

items.titleEn: Arsenal Football Camps return to Italy
items.summaryEn: Arsenal Football Development is delighted to announce a partnership with Team Italia Sport Services (TISS)
bodyEn: Arsenal Football Development is delighted to announce a partnership with Team Italia Sport Services (TISS), who have been dedicated to the development of young footballers for over 20 years through high-quality camps, structured training programmes, and international tournaments.
The organisation’s mission is to deliver comprehensive development experiences where technical ability, mindset, and educational values grow together.

TISS is a leading reference in Italy thanks to its long-standing collaborations with major professional clubs, delivering high-level programmes across the country. In the summer of 2025 alone, TISS successfully organised 48 camps, involving more than 2,000 players aged between 6 and 15.

Following a highly successful partnership between 2006 and 2017, TISS is proud to renew its collaboration with Arsenal Football Development. This new chapter brings great enthusiasm and a shared commitment to delivering an authentic Arsenal experience to young players in Italy.

The 2026 Arsenal Camps in Italy will follow the Strong Young Gunner model focusing on the holistic development of each participant. Sessions will emphasise technical skills, game understanding, leadership, and personal growth, creating a unique environment where players can develop both on and off the pitch.

The camps will take place in four selected locations across Italy: Villafranca di Verona, Cesenatico, Cascia, and Rivisondoli, offering participants the opportunity to experience the Arsenal Football Development methodology in high-quality environments across different regions of the country.
For more information on how to book please visit https://www.arsenalcamptiss.com.

items.titleZh: 阿森纳足球训练营重返意大利
items.summaryZh: 阿森纳青训发展部宣布与TISS达成合作，训练营将于2025年夏季在意大利四个地点举办。
bodyZh: 阿森纳足球发展部很高兴宣布与Team Italia Sport Services (TISS)建立合作关系，该公司20多年来一直致力于通过高质量的训练营、结构化的训练计划和国际赛事来发展年轻足球运动员。
该组织的使命是提供全面的发展体验，使技术能力、心态和教育价值观共同成长。
凭借与各大职业俱乐部的长期合作，以及在全国范围内提供的高水平项目，TISS成为了意大利的领先参考标准。仅在2025年夏天，TISS就成功举办了48场训练营，吸引了2000多名6至15岁的球员参与。
继2006年至2017年期间取得巨大成功之后，TISS很荣幸能与阿森纳足球发展部续签合作关系。这一新篇章带来了巨大的热情和共同的承诺，旨在为意大利的年轻球员提供正宗的阿森纳体验。
2026年意大利阿森纳训练营将遵循“坚强年轻枪手”（Strong Young Gunner）模式，重点关注每位参与者的全面发展。训练课程将强调技术、比赛理解、领导力和个人成长，为球员在场上和场下创造一个独特的成长环境。
训练营将在意大利的四个精选地点举行：维拉弗兰卡迪韦罗纳、切塞纳蒂科、卡西亚和里维松多利，为参与者提供在全国不同地区的高质量环境中体验阿森纳足球发展方法的机会。
有关如何预订的更多信息，请访问 https://www.arsenalcamptiss.com。

items.titleEn: Arsenal Football Development Croatia 2026
items.summaryEn: We are delighted to announce that our camps will be running at Falkensteiner Punta Skala Resort for 11 weeks this summer
bodyEn: We are delighted to announce that our camps will be running at the unique setting of Falkensteiner Punta Skala Resort near Zadar for 11 weeks this summer for the first time.
In an environment that blends the sea, premium infrastructure and sporting energy, young footballers will have the opportunity to train at a luxurious resort.

Each training session is delivered to develop players to become the best they can be and inspire a lifelong passion for the sport. Arsenal Football Development’s training programme is based on teaching young gunners the same techniques, skills and Game IQ the academy players learn at the official Arsenal Youth Academy at Hale End and is designed to give players an understanding of what it takes to play for Arsenal.
Representatives of Falkensteiner emphasise that welcoming the Arsenal Football Camps is a natural continuation of their sports-oriented vision:

“Falkensteiner Punta Skala Resort is a destination where renowned sports names find ideal conditions for training, active holidays, motivation and inspiration. Football, tennis and swimming academies, sporting competitions, tennis camps alongside ATP legends, as well as numerous courts for mini golf, volleyball, badminton, padel and beach volleyball are just part of our extensive sports offering. We are extremely proud that the Arsenal Football Camps are becoming part of this story, as it represents a strong upgrade to our active and sports philosophy.

“We at Arsenal Football Development are truly excited to continue expanding our programme in Croatia in 2026. This summer, in partnership with Falkensteiner Hotels, we are proud to deliver 11 full weeks of football camps. Through our Strong Young Gunner model, we will welcome children from all over the world to this exceptional resort, with every training session inspired by the proven philosophy of the Arsenal Academy. Our goal is for every participant to leave not only with new skills and knowledge, but also with unforgettable memories that will last a lifetime” -Vjekoslav Roguljić, Director of Arsenal Football Development Croatia.
The Arsenal Football Camp is available for stays of a minimum of five nights between 22 June and 4 September 2026, subject to availability and selected travel dates. The Arsenal package includes:

items.summaryZh: 阿森纳宣布今年夏天将在克罗地亚举办为期11周的训练营。
bodyZh: 我们很高兴地宣布，今年夏天我们的训练营将首次在扎达尔附近的Falkensteiner蓬塔斯卡拉度假村这一独特环境中举办，为期11周。
在融合了大海、优质基础设施和运动活力的环境中，年轻球员将有机会在豪华度假村进行训练。
每堂训练营的课程都旨在帮助球员成为最好的自己，并激发他们对这项运动终身的热爱。阿森纳足球发展的训练项目基于向小枪手们传授黑尔恩德官方阿森纳青训营学员所学习的相同技术、技能和比赛智商，旨在让球员了解为阿森纳效力需要具备什么。
Falkensteiner的代表强调，迎接阿森纳足球训练营是其体育导向愿景的自然延续：
“Falkensteiner蓬塔斯卡拉度假村是一个让知名体育大咖找到理想训练、积极度假、动力和灵感条件的胜地。足球、网球和游泳学院、体育比赛、与ATP传奇球星同场的网球训练营，以及众多用于迷你高尔夫、排球、羽毛球、板网球和沙滩排球的场地，只是我们广泛体育服务的一部分。我们非常自豪阿森纳足球训练营能够成为这个故事的一部分，因为这代表了我们积极和体育理念的强有力提升。”

“我们阿森纳足球发展部门对2026年在克罗地亚继续扩大我们的项目感到非常兴奋。今年夏天，我们很自豪能与Falkensteiner酒店合作，提供整整11周的足球训练营。通过我们的‘坚强小枪手’模式，我们将欢迎来自世界各地的儿童来到这个杰出的度假村，每一次训练都受到阿森纳青训营经过验证的哲学的启发。我们的目标是让每位参与者离开时不仅带走新的技能和知识，还有终生难忘的回忆”——克罗地亚阿森纳足球发展总监维耶科斯拉夫·罗古利奇（Vjekoslav Roguljić）。

items.titleEn: Arsenal Football Camps coming to Sweden in 2026
items.summaryEn: Arsenal Football Development came to Sweden in August 2026
bodyEn: For the first time ever, Arsenal Football Development is coming to Sweden this August and the interest is already remarkable. This summer, more than 200 young players from across the country will gather at Vallentuna IP outside Stockholm, where Arsenal will host its very first football camp on Swedish soil.

The camp welcomes both boys and girls born between 2011 and 2018 and also includes dedicated groups for goalkeepers. Regardless of skill level, participants will have the chance to develop in a safe, inspiring environment shaped by Arsenal Football Development’s training methodology.

“Arsenal Football Development are delighted to announce a partnership with CoachenEvents, who will operate the Arsenal Football Camps in Sweden. CoachenEvents have delivered major international football camps for more than 15 years. Now, the focus is on helping Swedish talents become Strong Young Gunners.” – Marc Thorogood, Arsenal Football Development Business and Operations Manager.

“Arsenal FC has long been one of the most popular clubs in Sweden, with a devoted fanbase and a strong connection to Swedish football. Today, players such as Stina Blackstenius, Smilla Holmberg, and Viktor Gyökeres continue to inspire a new generation and this camp offers young Swedish players an opportunity to get even closer to the club’s way of training and developing talent. With nationwide interest, high-quality organisation, and a unique collaboration with one of the world’s most beloved clubs, this camp marks the beginning of something truly special for Swedish youth football”. – Ola Blomkvist, owner of CoachenEvents.

“阿森纳足球发展项目非常高兴地宣布与CoachenEvents建立合作伙伴关系，后者将在瑞典运营阿森纳足球训练营。CoachenEvents拥有超过15年举办大型国际足球训练营的经验。现在，我们的重点是帮助瑞典天才成为坚强的年轻枪手。”——阿森纳足球发展业务与运营经理马克·索罗古德（Marc Thorogood）表示。

items.titleEn: Arsenal Football Development Georgia
items.summaryEn: In 2025 we were delighted to announce the start of Arsenal Football Development Georgia
bodyEn: In 2025 we were delighted to announce the start of Arsenal Football Development Georgia.

We ran a weeklong camp in Tbilisi and Kobuleti In June and August respectively where young players from all over the country came to partake in a high-quality and engaging football experience. Both camps attracted significant attention, with over 1,000 participants registering.

Iosebi Lomidze-Walsh, director of Arsenal Football Development Georgia and Arsenal academy coach stated “I am very proud to bring Arsenal to Georgia for the very first time. I have been working with the club for over 10 years, delivering a range of football projects, and in recent years, working with some of the best young talents in the country at the Arsenal Academy so it is a privilege to be able to use this experience gained at Arsenal to coach young players in my home country”

Arsenal Football Development Georgia’s aim is to highlight the importance of technical detail within the curriculum, supporting children to learn new skills and further develop their technique. This will help them perform more effectively during tactical games.

Teko, one of our participants’ mothers said “Dati had the best time and will remember this camp for a very long time. He loved the skills he learned, which I’m sure will benefit him when he returns to his club”.

Due to this success and increasing demand, we are planning to deliver two more camps this summer, one in Tbilisi and another in Kutaisi. For more information on how to book please visit ‘Arsenal FD – Georgia' on Facebook or email ilomidze-walsh@arsenal.co.uk.

items.titleZh: 阿森纳足球发展项目登陆格鲁吉亚
items.summaryZh: 阿森纳在格鲁吉亚启动足球发展项目并成功举办训练营。
bodyZh: 在2025年，我们高兴地宣布阿森纳格鲁吉亚足球发展项目的启动。
我们分别于6月和8月在第比利斯和科布列蒂举办了为期一周的训练营，来自全国各地的年轻球员前来参加这一高质量且引人入胜的足球体验。两场训练营都吸引了广泛关注，注册人数超过1000人。
阿森纳格鲁吉亚足球发展项目主管兼阿森纳青训教练约瑟比·洛米泽-沃尔什（Iosebi Lomidze-Walsh）表示：“我非常自豪能首次将阿森纳带到格鲁吉亚。我与俱乐部合作超过10年，负责过一系列足球项目，近年来一直在阿森纳青训营与国内一些最优秀的年轻天才合作，因此能将在阿森纳获得的经验用于执教我祖国的年轻球员是一种荣幸。”
阿森纳格鲁吉亚足球发展项目的目标是强调课程中技术细节的重要性，支持孩子们学习新技能并进一步提高技术。这将帮助他们在战术比赛中发挥得更有效。
我们的其中一位学员的母亲特科（Teko）说：“达蒂（Dati）度过了最美好的时光，并且会很长时间记住这个训练营。他很喜欢学到的技能，我相信这在他回到自己的俱乐部时会对他有所帮助。”
由于这一成功和不断增长的需求，我们计划今年夏天再举办两个训练营，一个在第比利斯，另一个在库塔伊西。有关如何预订的更多信息，请访问 Facebook 上的 ‘Arsenal FD – Georgia’ 或发送电子邮件至 ilomidze-walsh@arsenal.co.uk。

items.titleEn: Arsenal Football UK Summer Camps Return for 2026
items.summaryEn: Find out what our camps have to offer
bodyEn: Our Arsenal Football Development residential UK summer camps, delivered in partnership with Exsportise Summer Schools, are back for another summer.

Running for six weeks across June, July and August 2026, the camps are hosted at four of the UK's top independent boarding schools: Worth School, Seaford College, Oundle School, and Haileybury School. All offering elite football facilities and comfortable residential accommodation.

Open to boys and girls aged 9–17 of all ability levels, this is an exclusive chance to train the Arsenal Way in the UK (England), the home of Arsenal Football Club, with official Arsenal Football Development coaches.

As ever, the camps draw players from across the globe, providing a unique opportunity to train and build friendships with students from more than 60 countries, including Spain, Italy, France, Germany, and across Asia, North America, and South America. This makes for an international environment that is as much a part of the experience as the football itself.
Coaching Methodology derived from the Arsenal Academy at Hale End: The Arsenal Way
Our camps are built on the same coaching methodology used at Arsenal's Hale End Academy in north London.

Sessions are challenging but enjoyable, covering technical and tactical development, match play, and the mental side of the game. The goal is simple: to make every player better, and to leave them with a genuine understanding of what it takes to play for Arsenal.

Boys and girls train together and are grouped by age and ability from day one. Goalkeepers are fully catered for, splitting time between position-specific drills and work with the outfield group. Every player receives an official certificate from our Arsenal Football Development coaches at the end of their stay, and Players of the Week are recognised and awarded by the Exsportise and Arsenal Football Development team.
Two Programme Options

Players can choose from two formats depending on what they want from their summer. Both programmes are built around the Strong Young Gunners model and its four pillars - Effective Team Player, Efficient Mover, Lifelong Learner, and Champion Mentality.

The All-Day Football programme offers 30 hours of Arsenal Football Development coaching per week for players who want to focus entirely on their game, with additional player workshops. Full details at arsenalfootballcampsuk.com.

The English Language + Football programme combines 15 hours of football coaching with 15 hours of English tuition per week, delivered by Exsportise's British Council-accredited EFL teaching team – recognised as the UK’s leading summer school for English + Sports. New for 2026, B2+ students will join the Step Up English programme: a more academic, student-led strand built around business pitches, presentations, and debates - practical skills that go well beyond the classroom. Find out more at https://www.exsportise.co.uk/

"2025 was another fantastic summer, and we are incredibly proud of what our young players achieved - on the pitch and in the classroom. The introduction of Step Up English for 2026 reflects our ambition to keep raising the bar for English Language learning with football. We want every student who comes to camp to leave not just a better footballer, but more confident, more capable, and ready for whatever comes next."– Bram van Asselt, Director, Exsportise.

Spaces are limited. Visit arsenalfootballcampsuk.com or www.exsportise.co.uk/arsenal-football-camp to find out more or secure your place for summer 2026 here: https://www.arsenalfootballcampsuk.com/book-now.

items.titleZh: 阿森纳足球英国夏令营2026年回归
items.summaryZh: 阿森纳足球发展英国夏令营将在2026年夏季回归，现已开放报名。
bodyZh: 我们与Exsportise暑期学校合作举办的阿森纳足球发展英国住宿夏令营将在今年夏天再次开启。
夏令营将于2026年6月、7月和8月期间持续六周，在英国四所顶尖独立寄宿学校举办：沃斯学校、锡福德学院、奥undle学校和黑利伯瑞学校。所有学校均提供精英足球设施和舒适的住宿条件。
夏令营面向9至17岁、各种水平的男孩和女孩开放，这是一个在阿森纳足球俱乐部所在地英国（英格兰），与阿森纳官方足球发展教练一起以“阿森纳之道”进行训练的独家机会。
和以往一样，夏令营吸引了来自全球各地的球员，提供了一个与来自西班牙、意大利、法国、德国以及亚洲、北美和南美等60多个国家的学员一起训练和建立友谊的独特机会。这营造了一个国际化的环境，这种体验与足球本身同样重要。
教练方法源自伦敦北部黑尔恩德的阿森纳青训营：阿森纳之道
我们的夏令营建立在阿森纳伦敦北部黑尔恩德青训营所使用的相同教练方法基础之上。
训练课程既具挑战性又充满乐趣，涵盖技术与战术发展、比赛实战以及比赛的心理层面。目标很简单：让每位球员变得更好，并让他们真正理解为阿森纳踢球需要具备什么。
男孩和女孩一起训练，从第一天起按年龄和能力分组。守门员也会得到全面照顾，时间将在专项训练和与 outfield 球员的训练之间分配。每位球员在结束行程时都会获得阿森纳足球发展教练颁发的官方证书，每周最佳球员将获得 Exsportise 和阿森纳足球发展团队的认可和奖励。
两种项目选项
球员可以根据他们对夏天的期望选择两种形式。这两个项目都是围绕“强健年轻枪手”模式及其四个支柱构建的——高效团队球员、高效移动者、终身学习者和冠军心态。
全天足球项目为希望完全专注于比赛的球员提供每周30小时的阿森纳足球发展教练指导，并设有额外的球员研讨会。完整详情请访问 arsenalfootballcampsuk.com。
英语+足球项目将每周15小时的足球训练与15小时的英语教学相结合，由Exsportise经英国文化协会认证的EFL教学团队授课——该团队被公认为英国领先的英语+体育夏校。2026年新推出的是B2+学生将加入“进阶英语”项目：一个更加学术化、以学生为主导的模块，围绕商业路演、演讲和辩论展开——这些是超越课堂的实用技能。了解更多信息请访问 https://www.exsportise.co.uk/
“2025年是又一个精彩的夏天，我们对年轻球员在球场上和课堂上取得的成就感到无比自豪。2026年引入‘进阶英语’反映了我们不断提高英语学习与足球结合标准的雄心。我们希望来到夏令营的每个学生离开时不仅是一个更好的足球运动员，而且更自信、更有能力，为接下来的任何挑战做好准备。”——Exsportise总监Bram van Asselt。
名额有限。请访问 arsenalfootballcampsuk.com 或 www.exsportise.co.uk/arsenal-football-camp 了解更多信息，或在此处预订2026年夏天的名额：https://www.arsenalfootballcampsuk.com/book-now。
